unitTitle: Past Simple - A/An/The - Will - Linking Words

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in a, an or the where necessary. (continued from page 46)
exercises.instructionUz: Kerak bo'lgan joyga a, an yoki the ni qo'ying. (46-betdan davomi)
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu — 46-betdagi 15-mashqning DAVOMI (11-23-bandlar).

QOIDALARNI ESLANG:

  ARTIKL QO'YILMAYDI:
     ism, shahar, mamlakat  Tom, Ottawa, Brazil
     'these/those' bo'lsa   these eggs
     -ing shakli (mashg'ulot) swimming
     son bo'lsa             two uncles

  A / AN QO'YILADI:
     kasb                   a pilot, a nurse
     birinchi marta, birlik a computer, a film
     unli tovush oldidan    an aeroplane, an aunt

  THE QO'YILADI:
     ma'lum narsa           the fridge
     yagona narsa           the capital of France
     daryo nomlari          the Danube, the Amazon
     cholg'u asboblari      the guitar

items.textEn: 11  My name is ............ Tom.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz: 'Tom' — ATOQLI OT (ism) → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.

items.textEn: 11  I am from ............ Ottawa.  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'Ottawa' — ShAHAR nomi (Kanada poytaxti) →
artikl QO'YILMAYDI.

items.textEn: 12  Is there any milk in ............ fridge?
items.whyUz:
'THE fridge' — gaplashuvchilarga MA'LUM bo'lgan
muzlatgich (uydagi) → THE.
'a fridge' = muzlatgich (umuman).

items.textEn: 13  Her father is ............ pilot.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
KASB → artikl SHART.
'pilot' — 'p' undosh tovush → A.

items.textEn: 13  He flies ............ aeroplane.  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'aeroplane' — 'a' UNLI tovush → AN.
'to fly' = uchmoq, uchirmoq.

items.textEn: 14  Jim has got ............ two uncles ...  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'two' — SON allaqachon miqdorni ko'rsatgan →
artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
'a two uncles' XATO.

'aunt' — 'a' UNLI tovush → AN.
BIRLIK, birinchi marta aytilyapti.
'an aunt' = xola, amma.

items.textEn: 15  Dana went to ............ Brazil last summer.
items.whyUz:
'Brazil' — MAMLAKAT nomi → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
Coursebook 68-69-betlardagi hikoya ham Braziliya haqida edi.

items.textEn: 16  I don't want ............ hamburger for lunch.
items.whyUz:
BIRLIK sanaladigan ot, birinchi marta → A.
'hamburger' — 'h' undosh tovush (o'qiladi) → A.
'for lunch' — ovqat nomi artiklsiz.

items.textEn: 17  Paris is ............ capital of France.
items.whyUz:
'THE capital' — har mamlakatning poytaxti YAGONA → THE.
46-betdagi 15-mashqning 1-bandida ham shunday edi:
'Athens is THE capital of Greece'.

items.textEn: 18  Bill hasn't got ............ computer, but Alex has.
items.whyUz:
BIRLIK sanaladigan ot → A.
'but Alex has' = lekin Aleksda bor
('has got' qisqartirilgan).

items.textEn: 19  We saw ............ great film last night.
items.whyUz:
'great' — 'g' undosh tovush → A.
Birinchi marta aytilyapti.
see → SAW (noto'g'ri fe'l).

items.textEn: 20  Brenda likes ............ swimming ...  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'swimming' — MAShG'ULOT nomi (-ing shakli) →
artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
42-betdagi qoida: sport nomlari oldidan 'the' yo'q.

items.textEn: 20  ... but she doesn't like playing ............ guitar.  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'play THE guitar' — CHOLG'U ASBOBI oldidan THE SHART.
DIQQAT — BIR GAPDA IKKI QOIDA:
  swimming (sport)    → artikl YO'Q
  the guitar (cholg'u) → THE SHART
Bu farq ataylab bir gapga joylashtirilgan.

items.textEn: 21  ............ Danube isn't longer than ............ Amazon.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'THE Danube' — DARYO nomi → THE SHART.
Dunay — Yevropadagi daryo.
Coursebook 73-betda 'The Blue Danube' valsi bor edi.

items.textEn: 21  ... longer than ............ Amazon.  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'THE Amazon' — DARYO nomi → THE SHART.
42-betdagi qoidada shu misol bor edi.
'longer THAN' — qiyosiy daraja + than.

items.textEn: 22  How much are these ............ eggs?
items.whyUz:
'these' — KO'RSATISh olmoshi, u allaqachon
aniqlovchi vazifasini bajaradi → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
'these the eggs' XATO.
'How much are ...?' = qancha turadi?

items.textEn: 23  My mother is ............ nurse.
items.whyUz:
KASB → artikl SHART.
'nurse' — 'n' undosh tovush → A.
Coursebook 70-betdagi 3-mashqda 'a nurse' bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the short forms, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI QISQARTMA:

  will      → 'LL   (I'll, you'll, he'll, she'll,
                     it'll, we'll, they'll)
  will not  → WON'T (hamma ega uchun BIR XIL)

DIQQAT — 'WON'T' YOZILISHI:
  'will not' dan 'won't' hosil bo'ladi —
  yozilishi butunlay o'zgaradi.
  'willn't' shakli YO'Q.
  O'qilishi /wəʊnt/ ('vount').

DIQQAT — 'LL DAN KEYIN FE'L ASOSIY SHAKLDA:
  She'll GO.       ✓
  She'll GOES.     ✗ XATO
  She won't GO.    ✓
  She won't WENT.  ✗ XATO

items.textEn: 1  She will go to work.  →  She ............ go to work.
items.whyUz:
will → 'LL.
'She'll go to work.'

items.textEn: 2  I will not study.  →  I ............ study.
items.whyUz:
will not → WON'T.
'I won't study.'
DIQQAT: 'willn't' shakli YO'Q.

items.textEn: 3  He will do the shopping.  →  He ............ do the shopping.
items.whyUz:
will → 'LL.
'He'll do the shopping.'
'do the shopping' = xarid qilmoq.

items.textEn: 4  You will not cook dinner.  →  You ............ cook dinner.
items.whyUz:
will not → WON'T.
'You won't cook dinner.'

items.textEn: 5  I will play tennis.  →  I ............ play tennis.
items.whyUz:
will → 'LL.
'I'll play tennis.'
'play tennis' — sport oldidan artikl YO'Q.

items.textEn: 6  She will not go to school.  →  She ............ go to school.
items.whyUz:
will not → WON'T.
'She won't go to school.'
'go to school' — artikl YO'Q (o'qish ma'nosida).

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the prompts to write sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib gaplar yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  It/not be/sunny today.
  SA: It WON'T BE sunny today.
  SB: WILL it BE sunny tomorrow, then?

IKKI GAP QOLIPI:
  SA (INKOR):  [ega] WON'T [asosiy fe'l] ... TODAY/TONIGHT.
  SB (SO'ROQ): WILL [ega] [asosiy fe'l] ... TOMORROW, THEN?

UCH DIQQAT:

  1) SA da BUGUN, SB da ERTAGA —
     ko'rsatmadagi vaqt SB da 'tomorrow' ga o'zgaradi.

  2) 'then' = unda, u holda —
     gap OXIRIDA, oldidan VERGUL.

  3) 'won't' va 'will' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.

DIQQAT — SB DAGI EGA:
  Agar SA da 'I' bo'lsa, SB da 'YOU' bo'ladi —
  chunki boshqa odam gapiryapti.
     SA: I won't tidy MY room.
     SB: Will YOU tidy YOUR room tomorrow?

items.question: It won't be sunny today.
items.answer: Will it be sunny tomorrow, then?
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'won't BE' — 'be' asosiy shaklda.
Ob-havo haqida ega — DOIM 'it'.

items.question: She won't do the shopping today.
items.answer: Will she do the shopping tomorrow, then?
items.whyUz:
'won't DO' / 'Will she DO' — asosiy shakl.
'do the shopping' = xarid qilmoq.

items.question: He won't cook dinner tonight.
items.answer: Will he cook dinner tomorrow, then?
items.whyUz:
'dinner' oldidan artikl YO'Q.
'tonight' = bugun kechqurun.

items.question: I won't go to the cinema tonight.
items.answer: Will you go to the cinema tomorrow, then?
items.whyUz:
DIQQAT: SA da 'I', SB da 'YOU' —
boshqa odam savol beryapti.
'go to THE cinema' — 'the' bilan.

items.question: Bill won't play football this afternoon.
items.answer: Will he play football tomorrow, then?
items.whyUz:
SB da ism o'rniga 'he' olmoshi ishlatiladi.
'this afternoon' = bugun tushdan keyin.
'play football' — artikl YO'Q.

items.question: He won't visit his sister today.
items.answer: Will he visit his sister tomorrow, then?
items.whyUz: 'won't VISIT' — asosiy shakl ('visited' EMAS).

items.question: I won't tidy my room today.
items.answer: Will you tidy your room tomorrow, then?
items.whyUz:
DIQQAT: 'I' → 'you' va 'MY room' → 'YOUR room' —
egalik olmoshi ham o'zgaradi.

items.question: Carol won't go for a walk tonight.
items.answer: Will she go for a walk tomorrow, then?
items.whyUz:
SB da 'Carol' o'rniga 'she'.
'go FOR a walk' = sayr qilmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in will ('ll) or will not (won't).
exercises.instructionUz: will ('ll) yoki will not (won't) ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
MANTIQQA QARAB TANLANADI:

  Gap IJOBIY bashoratmi yoki OGOHLANTIRIShmi?
     → WILL
  Gap SALBIY bashoratmi yoki 'bo'lmaydi' degan
  ma'nodami?
     → WON'T

ENG MUHIM QOLIP — 'OR' BILAN OGOHLANTIRISH:
  [buyruq] OR you WILL/WON'T ... !
  = ...qil, aks holda ...

  Ikki xil natija bo'lishi mumkin:
     Hurry OR you WON'T catch the bus.
     (Shoshil, aks holda avtobusga YETIB OLMAYSAN.)
     Watch out OR you'LL hit your head.
     (Ehtiyot bo'l, aks holda boshingni URIB OLASAN.)

  Farqi: birinchisida YAXShI narsa bo'lmaydi (won't),
  ikkinchisida YOMON narsa bo'ladi (will).

DIQQAT — 8-BAND ALDAMCHI:
  'I DON'T THINK it ...... be sunny tomorrow.'
  Inkor 'don't think' da — shuning uchun keyingi
  qismda WILL (won't EMAS).
  Ingliz tilida inkor BIRINCHI fe'lga ko'chiriladi.

items.textEn: 1  Don't forget to take your gloves. It ............ be cold tomorrow.
items.hintUz: Qo'lqop olish kerak — demak sovuq BO'LADI
items.whyUz:
MANTIQ: qo'lqop olish kerak → sovuq BO'LADI → WILL.
'gloves' — qo'lqoplar (Coursebook 69-betda ham bor edi).
Ob-havo haqida ega — 'it'.

items.textEn: 2  Hurry or you ............ catch the bus!
items.whyUz:
'Hurry OR ...' = shoshil, aks holda ...
Shoshilmasa avtobusga YETIB OLMAYDI → WON'T.
'catch the bus' = avtobusga yetib olmoq.

items.textEn: 3  "We haven't got any eggs."  "I ............ buy some."
items.whyUz:
Ayni damda qabul qilingan QAROR → WILL ('ll).
'I'll buy some' = men sotib olaman.
'some' = bir oz (tuxumlar o'rniga).

items.textEn: 4  Watch out or you ............ hit your head.
items.whyUz:
'Watch out OR ...' = ehtiyot bo'l, aks holda ...
Ehtiyot bo'lmasa boshini URIB OLADI → WILL.
2-band bilan SOLISHTIRING: u yerda yaxshi narsa
bo'lmaydi (won't), bu yerda yomon narsa bo'ladi (will).
'Watch out!' = ehtiyot bo'l! (Coursebook 69-betda ham).

items.textEn: 5  Put on your jacket or you ............ be cold.
items.whyUz:
Kurtka kiymasa SOVQOTADI → WILL.
'put on' = kiymoq.

items.textEn: 6  I don't like Paul so I ............ invite him to the party.
items.whyUz:
MANTIQ: yoqtirmaydi → taklif QILMAYDI → WON'T.
'so' = shuning uchun (natijani bog'laydi).

items.textEn: 7  I'm tired. I think I ............ stay at home tonight.
items.whyUz:
Charchagan → uyda QOLADI → WILL.
'I think I'll ...' = menimcha ...qilaman —
ayni damda qabul qilingan qaror.
'stay at home' = uyda qolmoq.

items.textEn: 8  I don't think it ............ be sunny tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
DIQQAT — ENG ALDAMCHI BAND.
Inkor allaqachon 'I DON'T THINK' da bor →
keyingi qismda WILL (won't EMAS).
'I don't think it will ...' = menimcha ...bo'lmaydi.
Ingliz tilida inkor BIRINCHI fe'lga ko'chiriladi:
  I don't think it will rain.   ✓
  I think it won't rain.        (grammatik to'g'ri,
                                 lekin kam ishlatiladi)

items.textEn: 9  "Let's go to a restaurant."  "Great! I ............ cook dinner, then."
items.whyUz:
MANTIQ: restoranga borishadi → uyda ovqat PIShIRMAYDI →
WON'T.
'then' = unda, u holda (gap oxirida, oldidan vergul).
'Great!' = zo'r!

items.textEn: 10  It ............ be rainy tomorrow so don't forget to take your umbrella.
items.hintUz: Soyabon olish kerak — demak yomg'ir YOG'ADI
items.whyUz:
MANTIQ: soyabon kerak → yomg'ir BO'LADI → WILL.
1-band bilan bir xil mantiq (qo'lqop → sovuq).
'rainy' = yomg'irli;  'an umbrella' = soyabon
(Coursebook 69-betda ham bor edi).

exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQ 1-10 UNITLARNI TEKSHIRADI:
  present simple, present continuous, past simple,
  savol so'zlari, some/any, egalik, muloyim taklif.

ZAMON TANLASH — VAQT SO'ZIGA QARANG:

  PRESENT SIMPLE (fe'l, he/she/it → +S):
     every day, sometimes, rarely, in his free time
     va DOIMIY faktlar

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (am/is/are + -ing):
     at the moment, now,
     'What's he doing?' savoliga javob,
     'Where are you going?' savoliga javob

  PAST SIMPLE (o'tgan shakl):
     yesterday, last week, 2 years ago,
     tarixiy voqealar

BASHORAT SIFATIDA TEKSHIRING:
  Har bir bandda VAQT so'zini toping —
  u zamonni aniqlab beradi.

items.textEn: 1  I ............ a letter to my mum yesterday.
items.whyUz:
'yesterday' → PAST SIMPLE.
write → WROTE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'write TO somebody' — predlog TO.

items.textEn: 2  A: What's your brother doing?  B: He ............ the car.
items.whyUz:
Savol 'What's he DOING?' — PRESENT CONTINUOUS →
javob ham shu zamonda.
'He' BIRLIK → IS + washing.

items.textEn: 3  Kim ............ the bus to work every day.
items.whyUz:
'every day' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'Kim' 3-shaxs BIRLIK → take + S = TAKES.
'A taking' — yordamchi fe'lsiz -ing ishlatilmaydi.
'take the bus' = avtobusda bormoq.

items.textEn: 4  Christopher Columbus ............ America.
items.whyUz:
TARIXIY voqea (1492-yil) → PAST SIMPLE.
discover → discovered (to'g'ri fe'l).
Kolumb allaqachon vafot etgan — hozirgi zamon mumkin emas.

items.textEn: 5  A: Where are you going?  B: We ............ to the beach.
items.whyUz:
Savol 'Where ARE you GOING?' — PRESENT CONTINUOUS →
javob ham shu zamonda.
'We' KO'PLIK → ARE + going.

items.textEn: 6  Jerry ............ to music in his free time.
items.hintUz: 'in his free time' — odatmi yoki hozirmi?
items.whyUz:
'in his free time' = bo'sh vaqtida — ODAT →
PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Jerry' 3-shaxs BIRLIK → listen + S = LISTENS.
'listen TO music' — predlog TO shart.

items.textEn: 7  I ............ History at university 2 years ago.
items.whyUz:
'2 years ago' → PAST SIMPLE.
study → STUDIED ('d' undosh + 'y' → -IED).
'at university' — o'qish ma'nosida artikl YO'Q.

items.textEn: 8  Sophie rarely ............ TV in the evening.
items.whyUz:
'rarely' = kamdan-kam — CHASTOTA ravishi →
PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Sophie' 3-shaxs BIRLIK → watch + ES = WATCHES.
DIQQAT: oxiri 'ch' bo'lsa -ES qo'shiladi.

items.textEn: 9  A: Where's Peter?  B: He ............ the shopping at the moment.
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'He' BIRLIK → IS + doing.
'do the shopping' = xarid qilmoq.

items.textEn: 10  I ............ my grandparents last week.
items.whyUz:
'last week' → PAST SIMPLE.
visit → visited (to'g'ri fe'l).

items.textEn: 11  ............ do lions live?
items.whyUz:
'live' fe'li JOYNI so'raydi → WHERE.
'How many' son so'raydi;  'What' narsa so'raydi.
'Where do lions live?' = Sherlar qayerda yashaydi?
DIQQAT: 'lions' ko'plik → DO (does emas).

items.textEn: 12  Are there ............ cars in the street?
items.whyUz:
SO'ROQ gap → ANY.
'some' tasdiq gapda ishlatiladi.
'a' + ko'plik ot ('cars') mumkin emas.

items.textEn: 13  A: ............ Alice?  B: She's my sister.
items.whyUz:
Javob ODAM haqida ('my sister') → 'WHO'S Alice?'
'Who's' = 'Who is' ning qisqartmasi.
DIQQAT — ADAShTIRMANG:
  Who's = Who IS (kim?)
  Whose = kimning? (egalik)
Agar 'Whose' bo'lsa, javob 'It's Tom's' bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 14  ............ you like some ice cream?
items.whyUz:
'WOULD you like ...?' = ...xohlaysizmi? —
muloyim TAKLIF qilishning standart iborasi.
'Do you like ice cream?' = muzqaymoq YOQADIMI?
(umumiy fikr, taklif emas).
'Can you like' — mantiqsiz.
DIQQAT: taklifda 'some' ishlatiladi ('any' emas).

items.textEn: 15  Mark sometimes ............ long hours.
items.whyUz:
'sometimes' = ba'zan — CHASTOTA ravishi →
PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Mark' 3-shaxs BIRLIK → work + S = WORKS.
'work long hours' = uzoq soatlar ishlamoq.

groups.explanationUz: Bu ro'yxatni yodlab qo'ysangiz, xato kamayadi.

items.base: Hurry or you WON'T catch the bus.
items.baseUz: Shoshil, aks holda avtobusga yetib olmaysan.

items.base: Watch out or you'LL hit your head.
items.baseUz: Ehtiyot bo'l, aks holda boshingni urib olasan.

items.base: Put on your jacket or you'LL be cold.
I DON'T THINK it WILL rain.

groups.explanationUz: Bu so'zlar PRESENT SIMPLE ni talab qiladi.

items.base: every day / in his free time

patterns.formula: Ega + WON'T + ASOSIY fe'l ... TODAY.   →   WILL + ega + ASOSIY fe'l ... TOMORROW, THEN?
patterns.exampleEn: It won't be sunny today. — Will it be sunny tomorrow, then?
patterns.exampleUz: Bugun quyoshli bo'lmaydi. — Unda ertaga quyoshli bo'ladimi?
patterns.explanationUz:
'won't' va 'will' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.
'then' gap oxirida, oldidan vergul.

patterns.exampleEn: Hurry or you won't catch the bus! Watch out or you'll hit your head.
patterns.exampleUz: Shoshil, aks holda avtobusga yetib olmaysan! Ehtiyot bo'l, aks holda boshingni urib olasan.
patterns.explanationUz:
'or' = aks holda.
Natija yaxshi bo'lmasa → won't;  yomon bo'lsa → will.

patterns.formula: I DON'T THINK + ega + WILL + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: I don't think it will be sunny tomorrow.
patterns.explanationUz:
Inkor BIRINCHI fe'lga ('don't think') ko'chiriladi —
keyingi qismda 'will' qoladi.

patterns.formula: Ega + likes + SWIMMING (sport)  BUT  doesn't like playing THE guitar (cholg'u).
patterns.exampleEn: Brenda likes swimming but she doesn't like playing the guitar.
patterns.exampleUz: Brenda suzishni yoqtiradi, lekin gitara chalishni yoqtirmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Sport → artikl YO'Q;  cholg'u → THE SHART.

patterns.formula: THE + daryo nomi + isn't longer THAN + THE + daryo nomi.
patterns.exampleEn: The Danube isn't longer than the Amazon.
patterns.explanationUz:
Daryo nomlari oldidan THE SHART.
'longer THAN' — qiyosiy daraja + than.

patterns.exampleEn: Would you like some ice cream?
